about: The user-walker's calibration (board 318; R3 §4; ships into every project, board 1789). Each case is a deployed revision of mamamemory the walker walks three times (`walker.py request j-N --calibration <case> ...`); `walker.py calibrate` reads the last walk of each. A seeded defect is found when a finding of one of its kinds recurred in 2 of 3 runs. The walker is on only with need_seeded found and at most max_false counted findings (kind other than unclear_text) on the clean revision. `goal` is what the walker is told when the project has no sealed journey j-N (the person's goal, never the steps); `budget` is the step budget of such a walk.
